comment: Offline fallback list bundled with the app. The remote list (Settings > Update) overrides this at runtime. Format is backwards compatible with the array-of-arrays layout used by aihub-config-data; the optional 6th element is `requiresLogin` (true = needs an account, false = works with no sign-in).
